description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development. The ideal candidate will be passionate about fostering a supportive environment and upholding the highest standards of quality.

As the Director of Nursing, you will oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of compassionate and effective care to our residents. You will play a crucial role in staff management, regulatory compliance, and continuous quality improvement initiatives. We are looking to fill this vital leadership position quickly and offer a competitive salary for the right professional.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a DON or ADON
Demonstrated knowledge of state and federal long-term care regulations
Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: We offer a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, commensurate with experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN Preferred) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate and the chance to play a crucial role in resident care and regulatory compliance.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for managing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) process, ensuring accurate and timely assessments, and contributing to the development of comprehensive, individualized care plans for our residents. Your expertise will be vital in maintaining compliance with all state and federal regulations, including Medicare and Medicaid guidelines.

This role is perfect for a detail-oriented professional committed to enhancing the quality of life for residents through precise documentation and collaborative care planning. Join a team that values clinical excellence and provides a supportive environment for professional growth.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficiency with the Minimum Data Set (MDS) 3.0 and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Strong understanding of Medicare and Medicaid regulations related to MDS
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00, based on experience.

description: We are seeking a dedicated Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Missouri Valley, IA. This is a permanent, full-time opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing leader ready to make a lasting impact on patient care and staff development.As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily clinical operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Your leadership will be vital in maintaining high-quality care and operational excellence within the facility.This position offers a chance to contribute to a supportive team dedicated to resident well-being. We are looking for a professional who is committed to a long-term role and eager to grow with our organization.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with at least 1 year in a leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and standards
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL, as a Full-time MDS Coordinator. This critical role is the second position in our MDS department, working alongside an experienced lead. Our facility is a 120-bed center with an average Medicare A census of 35-45, managing 15-20 cases. We pride ourselves on our 5-star Quality Measures and recently opened an in-house Dialysis Suite, enhancing our patient care capabilities.

We are actively seeking a dedicated professional to contribute to our team. While we have two openings in the MDS department, our current staff is diligently assisting to ensure we remain on track. This is an excellent opportunity to make an immediate impact in a supportive environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license
Minimum of 1 year of recent experience in MDS coordination
Proficiency with the Patient-Driven Payment Model (PDPM)
Experience working in a skilled nursing facility setting
